timeline.event: LMCS (Land and Marine Contracting Services Ltd) began contract work on Paria Fuel Trading's 30-inch submarine pipeline at Pointe-a-Pierre (Sealine No. 36, riser at Berth 6).

Five LMCS divers (Christopher Boodram, Fyzal Kurban, Rishi Nagassar, Kazim Ali Jr, Yusuf Henry) prepared to work in an underwater 'habitat' (dry chamber kept at about 10-15 psi by an air compressor) on the Sealine 36 riser at Berth 6. The job was to remove a blank and two plugs and join a new riser section. Boodram testified that Delta P was not discussed at the morning toolbox meeting.

After lunch the crew removed the mechanical plug and began deflating the inflatable plug. The habitat flooded and all five men were sucked into the 30-inch line by a sudden pressure equalisation (Delta P). The helmet camera's video was lost at that moment but its audio kept recording. CoE counsel Ramesh Lawrence Maharaj SC gave about 2:45 pm. Other reports give 2:15 pm (Express, citing 'official accounts'), about 2:30 pm (Paria, Express) and about 3 pm (Wikipedia).
According to evidence summarised by CoE counsel, LMCS drew up an initial plan to send scuba divers in to reach the trapped men.

Inside the pipe all five men were alive and talking in pitch darkness, in oil and water and in air pockets. Several were injured: Henry had a broken leg or foot, Kurban was in pain, Ali Jr was badly hurt, and Boodram had injured his left arm. They dragged themselves along the horizontal section in a chain. Boodram eventually went ahead alone, used scuba tanks he found in the pipe, and reached the vertical riser below the habitat.

timeline.date: 25 Feb 2022, between about 4:30 pm and about 6:00 pm
timeline.event: Volunteer divers Ronald Ramoutar and Corey Crawford pulled Boodram out of the habitat, entering without Paria's permission. He told them the other four were alive and that Kurban was right behind him. Accounts of the time differ: CoE counsel Maharaj said 4:30-4:45 pm; Paria said it learned the men were in the pipe only when Boodram emerged, about 5:30 pm; the Express reports 5:45 pm; Newsday quoted counsel saying 6 pm. He is usually described as having spent roughly 2-3 hours in the pipe; the CoE chair said 2-3 hours. He was taken by ambulance to San Fernando General Hospital.
Paria began open-water sea searches for the four men after learning of Boodram's rescue. The CoE later criticised it for spending hours searching open water.

LMCS revised its plan to pumping surface air into the pipeline. LMCS says Paria had blocked the original plan as unsafe. Michael Kurban (Fyzal's son), using an umbilical, entered a short way with Ramoutar and Crawford but could not go far because the umbilical was too short and the equipment was insufficient.

According to Ramoutar's sworn statement, Paria officials told the volunteers to wait for Coast Guard divers, then told them they had no permission to enter the pipeline. He said: 'They used the Coast Guard to stop us.' Coast Guard evidence was that its divers lacked commercial equipment and training for a pipeline entry. Paria's incident commander, terminal operations manager Collin Piper, did not sanction any entry into the pipe, citing responder safety.
According to CoE counsel, Paria first questioned Boodram about conditions inside the pipeline about four hours after he came out.

A message about 12 hours after the incident referred to working drafts of press releases on moving 'from rescue to recovery' (Express, from CoE evidence). Relatives say cameras were not sent into the pipe until about 12 hours after the incident.

Remote cameras and crawlers were sent into the line; an ROV reached up to about 450 ft before hitting an obstruction thought to be the inflatable plug. An attempt to position a water pump stalled when its lifting cable snapped (relatives' account). Paria says it told families of the shift to recovery on 26 Feb between 6 and 9 pm; relatives deny this.

At a news conference, Paria chairman Newman George and general manager Mushtaq Mohammed announced that the operation had moved 'from rescue to recovery'. Mohammed cited 'the extremely low likelihood of survival and the risk of placing human life in danger.'
The bodies of Fyzal Kurban, Kazim Ali Jr and Yusuf Henry were recovered by pushing pressurised water through the line.

timeline.date: Night of 2-3 Mar 2022 (12:36 am, 3 Mar per Express)
timeline.event: Rishi Nagassar's body, the last of the four, was recovered. A foam 'pig' was pushed through from Berth 5. He was found lodged behind equipment about 60 ft below the surface and more than 100 ft into the pipeline. Some outlets date this 2 March.

The government announced a Commission of Enquiry: chair Justice (Cecil) Dennis Morrison QC of Jamaica, with local subsea specialist Gregory Wilson. Instruments of appointment followed around 21-22 April 2022.
Boodram's first in-depth account, a Sunday Express interview by Anna Ramdass at Freedom Law Chambers, his lawyers' office.
Morrison resigned for personal reasons. Cabinet named Jerome Lynch KC as chair; Gregory Wilson stayed on as commissioner and Ramesh Lawrence Maharaj SC as counsel.
The CoE held its first public sitting. Hearings were at Tower D, International Waterfront Centre, Port of Spain, and were livestreamed on the commission's website (coe2022.com).

First day of evidentiary hearings. 6 min 55 s of audio and video from Kazim Ali Jr's head-mounted GoPro (about 29 min in total) were played in public. Ali Jr's parents left the room, and virtual viewers were warned beforehand. CoE counsel presented pathologists' estimates that the four men survived for hours to days.
Boodram testified on day 2 of the hearings, the first witness, examined by Ramesh Lawrence Maharaj SC. He broke down several times. Chairman Lynch asked counsel to show restraint in questioning.

Collin Piper (Paria terminal operations manager and incident commander) testified that Paria 'could not sanction to sending somebody into that pipeline'. He claimed Boodram had said 'I ain't think dem fellas make it'; Boodram had earlier testified that he would not have said that.
In closing submissions, Paria's lawyer argued that the company had no legal responsibility to rescue the LMCS divers.
Lynch handed the final report to President Christine Kangaloo, saying the tragedy was 'no act of God' and that 'This report pulls no punches.'
OSHA filed a matter in the Industrial Court against Paria and LMCS.
The Sunday Guardian reported the report's contents, including the recommendation to investigate Paria for corporate manslaughter, before it was tabled.
Energy Minister Stuart Young laid the report in Parliament (52 recommendations; reported as 380 pages, 520 by the Express) and sent it to the DPP.

timeline.date: 2024 (proceedings under way by 2 Apr; individuals before court by Jul 2024)
timeline.event: OSHA, through Chief Inspector Franz Brisbane, brought 15 OSH Act charges in the San Fernando Magistrates' Court against Paria (4), GM Mushtaq Mohammed (4), Collin Piper (1), LMCS (3) and LMCS director Kazim Ali Snr (3). One commentator dates the charges to 10 Jul 2024.

DPP Roger Gaspard SC wrote to the Police Commissioner on 10 May advising a criminal investigation, and announced it publicly on 30-31 July. He said there is no statutory offence of corporate manslaughter in T&T; the only possible non-regulatory offence is manslaughter by gross negligence.
All defendants pleaded not guilty to the 15 OSH charges before Senior Magistrate Alicia Chankar.
Freedom Law Chambers (Anand Ramlogan SC) filed negligence suits for Boodram and Nagassar's family against Paria (29 grounds) and LMCS (25 grounds).
Police said independent local and international diving experts were assisting the criminal probe. No charges.

PM Stuart Young's Cabinet announced TT$1 million ex gratia payments, without admission of liability, to Boodram and to each of the four families, weeks before the 28 Apr 2025 election. Opposition leader Kamla Persad-Bissessar called it an election stunt. The UNC won and the payments were not made under Young.
Daily Mail (DMG Media) released the podcast 'Pipeline' (host Isabelle Stanley), with Boodram's first long-form interview and GoPro audio. It is copyrighted.

In UWI v OSH Authority [2025] UKPC 42, the Privy Council held that the six-month limit in s.93 of the OSH Act, running from when an inspector learns of the offence, applies to all OSH criminal offences, and that the two-year limit in s.97B applies only to civil proceedings. This put the Paria prosecutions at risk.
Boodram filed an amended negligence claim in the High Court; a case management conference was set for 5 May 2026.

PM Kamla Persad-Bissessar presented TT$1M ex gratia payments, without admission of liability, to Boodram and the families of Rishi Nagassar and Fyzal Kurban at the Diplomatic Centre, St Ann's. The Henry and Ali Jr families were still pending (letters of administration and insurance issues).

Kurban and Henry families filed High Court negligence claims (attorney Saira Lakhan, team of Prakash Ramadhar). On the 4th anniversary (25 Feb 2026), families said they had had no update on the police probe since early 2025.
High Court Master Wrenerson Lochan stayed the workmen's compensation claim by Kurban's widow until the negligence suits are decided.

Senior Magistrate Marisa Gomez took over the OSH case. Paria's new lawyers now back dismissal on time-limit grounds. Submissions were due 30 Sep and 30 Oct 2026, with a ruling or request for clarification expected 11 Dec 2026.

key_facts.fact: Victims: five LMCS divers were sucked in; four died: Fyzal Kurban (57, lead diver, 'Fyzie'), Kazim Ali Jr (36/37, 'Small Kaz'), Rishi Nagassar (48, also spelled Nagessar), Yusuf Henry (31, also 'Yusuff'). Sole survivor: Christopher Boodram (40 at the time). Kazim Ali Jr was the son of LMCS director Kazim Ali Snr.

Pipeline: a 30-inch (about 76 cm) submarine crude and fuel line, 'Sealine No. 36', with its riser at Berth 6 off Pointe-a-Pierre. Paria described it as horseshoe or U-shaped and about 400 m long; Stuart Young described a vertical drop of about 55 ft. The line was out of service for repair, not pumping. The '36' is the sealine number, not the diameter.

Cause (CoE finding): the primary root cause was the method Paria and LMCS used to empty the pipeline of its contents. It left a latent differential pressure ('Delta P'), with low pressure inside the line against higher pressure in the habitat and sea. When the plugs were removed the pressure equalised violently and pulled water and all five men into the line. The CoE also found the LMCS-Paria contract had no provision for Delta P, and an April 2022 OSHA preliminary report said neither company appeared to have considered it.

Who blocked the rescue and why: Paria's incident command (incident commander Collin Piper, terminal operations manager) did not allow LMCS or volunteer divers into the pipe. Paria said this was for responder safety and fear of a second Delta P event, with low odds of survival, and that the Coast Guard and external experts supported the decision. Volunteers (Ronald Ramoutar and others) say Paria refused permission and used the Coast Guard to stop them. Coast Guard divers said they lacked the equipment and training for the pipe. CoE: 'no rescue attempt was ever made by them'; Piper 'closed his mind to any alternatives without even hearing them'; LMCS was 'effectively prevented from pursuing a rescue by Paria.' The CoE nonetheless found that Piper's conduct fell short of individual criminal liability.

Key CoE conclusions: Rec. 40 found sufficient grounds that 'Paria's negligence could be characterised as gross negligence and consequently criminal', and did not reach that conclusion for LMCS. Rec. 41: the DPP should 'consider charging Paria with what is commonly known as Corporate Manslaughter.' Rec. 44: OSH proceedings against named individuals, deadline 24 Feb 2024. Rec. 39: immediate financial help for families ('This does not have to involve any admission of liability'). The report also called for compulsory diving regulation with criminal sanctions, a Delta P line on work permits, a hyperbaric chamber near the site, and annual incident-command drills. It found both companies 'created the danger' and both had a duty to attempt a rescue. It called Paria's treatment of families 'insensitive and uncivilised'. The commission cost about TT$15.5M.
Report length: most outlets (Guardian, CNC3, Stabroek) say 380 pages; the Express says 520 pages, possibly including annexes. Recommendations: 52.

Survival: the GoPro audio shows all five survived the initial suction and were talking. How long the four lived is disputed. State autopsies gave no time of death. Family-commissioned pathologist Prof Hubert Daisley estimated Ali Jr may have lived roughly 15 to 39 hours; a second post-mortem cited at the CoE suggested some may have lived until late on 27 Feb. These are expert estimates presented as evidence, not CoE findings.

REAL WORDS, setting 1: GoPro audio from Kazim Ali Jr's head camera, played at a CoE public hearing on 21 Nov 2022 (6:55 of about 29 min). The lines were transcribed differently by the Express and Guardian, and most are unattributed. Express lines: 'Where allyuh?' / 'We inside the pipe! We inside the pipeline!' / 'Ah inside the pipe, too' / 'Ah trying to come up' / 'Chriss! Chriss!' / 'All ah we in this together, we hadda go, we hadda start moving.' / 'Allyuh doh worry, God is good and he go geh we through dis!' (Express attributes this to Boodram) / 'Fyzie right behind.' / 'Yeah boy, my foot break!' (Express attributes this to Henry). Guardian attributions: Boodram 'Come allyuh! We have to go. All ah we in this together.'; Boodram 'I can't go more. I am pushing more oil.'; Ali Jr 'That is a stupid question' (chuckling, replying to 'Right here where?'); Kurban 'No boy.'; Henry 'Right now me and Fyzie together.'; Nagassar can be heard groaning but speaks no words.

REAL WORDS, setting 2: Boodram's sworn CoE testimony on 22 Nov 2022, recounting the pipeline. His own words: 'Allyuh, what going on? Look, this thing is filling up. Let we get out of here' (said in the habitat as it flooded, per CNC3 and the Express). 'At that point, I told myself that I would die. I said to God I am coming. Ma, look out for me.' 'Your eyes are burning... It is pitch black; you cannot see anything.' 'Small Kaz (Ali Jr) was holding me. I said I am not coming out the pipe without you all.' 'I swear to God it was the angel of death coming for me.' 'I failed them.' 'Fellahs, I coming back, I promise, I coming back' (Express). Words he says others spoke: Ali Jr, 'No. I in real pain. I mash up bad.' and 'We going and dead'; Henry, 'My foot break.'; Kurban, 'Christopher, I'm right here. Wait for me.' (Newsday wording).

REAL WORDS, setting 3: other Boodram interviews. Sunday Express, 13 Mar 2022 (print, at his lawyers' chambers): 'I told myself in my mind, this is the end. Mom, I'm coming.' and 'I have to go, brother boy. If I stay here, all of we will die, none of we will see our children.' CNC3 one-year interview, 23 Feb 2023: 'How I can teach my daughter to swim when I fraid to go in the water?' TTT 'T&T Today', 22-23 Jan 2026: 'It was Paria not allowing the contractors to do the rescue.' and 'It's a breath of fresh air.'

Contested statement: Piper's written statement claims that when Boodram came out he said 'I ain't think dem fellas make it.' Boodram testified that he 'would not say something like that.' Do not present Piper's version as fact.

Commission of Enquiry: first chaired by Justice C. Dennis Morrison QC (announced 10 Mar 2022; resigned June 2022), then by Jerome Lynch KC, with commissioner Gregory Wilson; counsel to the commission was Ramesh Lawrence Maharaj SC. Report delivered to the President 30 Nov 2023 and laid in Parliament 19 Jan 2024.

Boodram's escape (his testimony): the men moved in a chain through oily water about 8-10 inches deep. Ali Jr held on to his foot and begged him not to go, and he had to kick free. He found scuba tanks in the pipe ('like eating oil'), reached the riser, jumped repeatedly to grab a chain-block chain, and knocked on the pipe until someone knocked back. Ramoutar then entered, followed by Crawford.

facts.legal_status_2026:
As of 6 Nov 2026, from the latest reporting I found (to mid-Aug 2026); nothing found for Sept-Nov 2026.
(1) Criminal manslaughter: no one has been charged. The CoE (Jan 2024) recommended the DPP consider 'corporate manslaughter' against Paria. DPP Roger Gaspard SC (statement 30-31 Jul 2024) said T&T has no statutory offence of corporate manslaughter; the only possible non-regulatory offence is common-law manslaughter by gross negligence. He advised a TTPS investigation (letter of 10 May 2024). Police said in Feb 2025 that external diving experts were assisting. On the 4th anniversary (25 Feb 2026) families said they had had no update since early 2025 and police gave none. Status: investigation open, no charges.
(2) OSH Act prosecutions: OSHA brought 15 charges in the San Fernando Magistrates' Court, laid in 2024; a separate Industrial Court filing was made 13 Dec 2023. The defendants are Paria (4 charges), ex-GM Mushtaq Mohammed (4), terminal ops manager Collin Piper (1), LMCS (3) and LMCS director Kazim Ali Snr (3). All pleaded not guilty on 11 Sep 2024. The Privy Council's ruling in UWI v OSH Authority [2025] UKPC 42 (16 Sep 2025) confirmed a six-month limit from an inspector's knowledge. Whether the Paria charges are time-barred is a preliminary issue before Senior Magistrate Marisa Gomez. Paria's new lawyers and Mohammed and Piper's counsel now support dismissal; OSHA argues the clock ran from the Jan 2024 report. A ruling or request for clarification is expected 11 Dec 2026. The charges may be thrown out.
(3) Civil negligence suits, all pending with no judgment or settlement reported: Boodram and Nagassar's family filed 14 Oct 2024 (Freedom Law Chambers, Anand Ramlogan SC); Boodram filed an amended claim Nov 2025, with a case management conference on 5 May 2026 (outcome not found). Kurban and Henry families filed Feb 2026 (Saira Lakhan / Prakash Ramadhar), before Justices Sieuchand and Ayers-Caesar. Paria denies liability. LMCS blames Paria but admits owing workmen's compensation, pending its insurer (TRINRE) claim.
(4) Workmen's compensation: the Kurban widow's claim was stayed by Master Lochan (Mar 2026) until the negligence suits are decided. Earlier, Paria failed to get itself removed from the Kurban and Henry workmen's compensation claims (Nov 2025).
(5) Ex gratia: TT$1M each, without admission of liability. Announced by PM Stuart Young about 3 Apr 2025. Paid by PM Kamla Persad-Bissessar on 22 Jan 2026 to Boodram and the Nagassar and Kurban families. The Henry and Ali Jr families were still pending as of Apr 2026; I could not confirm payment since.
Wording for the reel: say 'the commission found / recommended', 'charged with OSH Act offences, pleaded not guilty, case pending', 'police investigation ongoing, no charges'. Do not say anyone 'was convicted', 'was charged with manslaughter' or 'murdered'.
myths: '4 or 5 people died': five divers were sucked in; four died and one (Christopher Boodram) survived.
'It was a 36-inch pipe': it was 30 inches (about 76 cm). 'No. 36' is the sealine's name. Some outlets (Express March 2022, Guardian) and Divernet's '90cm' figure repeat the error.
'It happened 26 February 2022': some outlets (Stabroek, the Express Lynch article) misdate it. The incident was Friday 25 Feb 2022.

'Boodram was trapped for five days': he was in the pipe roughly 2-3 hours and came out the same evening. The five days was the rescue-to-recovery period for the other four. Guardian (Feb 2025) and Sunday Guardian wording ('ordeal lasting five days') is misleading.
'All bodies were recovered five days later' or 'all on 28 Feb': three were recovered on 28 Feb; Nagassar was recovered about 12:36 am on 3 Mar (some outlets say 2 Mar).

'They died instantly': the GoPro audio and Boodram's testimony show all five survived the suction and talked, prayed and moved together. How long the four survived after that is disputed (pathologists' estimates range from hours to more than a day).

'The pipeline was live, pumping oil, or a valve was opened': it was out of service for repair. The CoE blamed a latent Delta P left by the method used to empty the line, released when the plugs were removed.

'They were in a hyperbaric chamber' (Wikipedia lead): it was a dry underwater work 'habitat' at the riser, not a medical hyperbaric chamber. The CoE recommended a hyperbaric chamber be available near such sites.

'Paria was charged with corporate manslaughter': it was not. The CoE only recommended that the DPP consider it. T&T has no statutory offence of that name. The charges actually laid are 15 OSH Act regulatory charges, which may be time-barred, and the police manslaughter probe has produced no charges.
'No one tried to rescue them': volunteer divers did pull Boodram out, and LMCS proposed plans. The CoE finding is that Paria made no rescue attempt and prevented LMCS from attempting one.

'Armed officers were sent to stop rescuers' (Daily Mail podcast framing): the volunteers' sworn account is that Paria told them to wait for the Coast Guard, and that the Coast Guard (who were armed) said they could not enter. Paria says the Coast Guard and experts supported its decision. Present it as attributed claims.
'The GoPro shows video of them inside': the video was lost at the moment of suction. The public material is mainly audio (6:55 of about 29 minutes).
'Boodram told Paria the others were dead': this comes from Piper's statement, and Boodram denies it under oath.

Viral TikTok/YouTube 'full transcript' and 'Paria pipeline audio' clips: many are re-edited, reordered or AI-voiced. No verified complete transcript exists, and Express and Guardian transcriptions of the same audio differ.

'LMCS was blameless' or 'LMCS was equally guilty': the CoE found both companies created the danger and had a duty to rescue, but singled out Paria as grossly negligent because it effectively prevented LMCS from rescuing.
facts.sensitivities:
1) The 'spliced in-pipe dialogue' request (the user's '짜집기'). Only verbatim lines from the three settings above may be used. Each must be labelled with its setting and date: 'GoPro audio, played at the CoE 21 Nov 2022', 'Boodram's CoE testimony 22 Nov 2022', 'Express interview 13 Mar 2022', and so on. Lines from different settings and days must not be cut together into one continuous 'conversation', and their order must not be rearranged to imply an exchange that was never recorded. GoPro lines may not be given to a named speaker unless the Express or Guardian attributes them, because most are unattributed and the two outlets' transcripts differ. Lines Boodram quotes others as saying should be captioned 'Boodram recalls Kazim saying...', not presented as recorded audio. Trinidadian Creole ('allyuh', 'we going and dead', 'mash up') needs careful Korean subtitling, ideally with the original shown. Do not invent any line, including 'last words'.
2) Using real audio. The GoPro recording carries the voices of the four dead men; Kazim Ali Jr's parents walked out when it was played. I strongly recommend not using the GoPro audio at all, or only with the families' consent; if it is used, use a few seconds with an advance content warning. Boodram's voice: the CoE livestream archive (coe2022.com) may be offline. Most surviving clips are copyrighted TV footage (CNC3, TV6, TTT) or the Daily Mail 'Pipeline' podcast, and reposting them in a monetised Reel risks takedowns and Content ID claims. Getting permission (Boodram via Freedom Law Chambers, or the broadcaster) is safest. Downloads from YouTube are usually blocked from this environment anyway.
3) Defamation and pending cases. Say 'the commission found' and 'the commission recommended the DPP consider'. Never say 'Paria killed' or 'murdered' in the narrator's voice. Boodram's March 2022 words ('Paria made a conscious decision to murder my friends... first degree murder') are his opinion; if used, they must be clearly attributed and are legally risky. Named individuals (Collin Piper, Mushtaq Mohammed, Kazim Ali Snr) have pleaded not guilty to regulatory OSH charges, and the CoE found Piper's conduct fell short of individual criminal liability. Avoid implying their personal guilt. Kazim Ali Snr is both a defendant and the father of a victim; Boodram and widow Vanessa Kussie said they would prefer he not be prosecuted.
4) Victims and survivor. Boodram has PTSD (flashbacks, fear of water) and is a plaintiff; portray his account respectfully and do not dramatise his trauma. Use agreed spellings (Rishi Nagassar/Nagessar, Yusuf/Yusuff Henry) and ideally confirm the in-memoriam card with the families or their lawyers. No gore, no re-enactment of deaths and no simulated 'last moments'. Code-drawn diagrams of the habitat, riser and Delta P are fine. Add a content warning at the start.
5) Facts to verify before scripting. The time of the incident (2:15-3:00 pm reported) and of Boodram's exit (4:30-6:00 pm) are disputed, so use 'about 2:45 pm' and 'about 2-3 hours later'. Report length is 380 vs 520 pages. Survival duration is disputed. Re-check the 11 Dec 2026 magistrate ruling and any police update just before posting, since the legal status may change.
6) Politics. The ex gratia payments became an election issue (Young/PNM vs Persad-Bissessar/UNC); keep the framing neutral.
7) Questions to put to the user: (a) Can we drop the GoPro audio and use only Boodram's own voice, with clips you hold rights or permission for? (b) Should Boodram-quoted lines from others be shown as subtitle cards rather than presented as audio? (c) Can the in-memoriam be cleared with the families?

reported_by: Newsday, 'CoE hears Paria survivor's tale: Nightmare', 23 Nov 2022: https://newsday.co.tt/2022/11/23/coe-hears-paria-survivors-tale-nightmare/ (full text read via mirror https://www.temponetworks.com/2022/11/23/coe-hears-paria-survivors-tale-nightmare/)
Newsday, 22 Nov 2022 (variant above)
Trinidad Express, 23 Nov 2022: "I wasn't sure if I was in hell or heaven"
T&T Guardian, 22 Nov 2022 (paraphrase): 'he admitted to not knowing if he was alive or dead, or in heaven or hell'
quotes.korean: 내가 천국에 있는 건지, 지옥에 있는 건지, 아니면 파이프 안에 있는 건지 알 수가 없었어요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (recounting his own shout inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: I was on my back. I begin crawling and dragging myself feet first along the pipeline when I start to hear screaming. I tell myself them fellas outside and looking for me. I yelled back, 'I coming! I coming! I'm inside the pipeline, I coming. I coming!'
quotes.context: First contact with the others in the dark air pocket, as he recounted it in the Sunday Express exclusive (interview 11 Mar 2022, published 13 Mar 2022).
reported_by: Sunday Express, 'The Day I Cheated Death', Anna Ramdass, 13 Mar 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 저는 등을 대고 누워 있었어요. 발부터 먼저 파이프라인을 따라 기어가며 몸을 끌고 있는데 비명 소리가 들리기 시작했어요. '밖에서 동료들이 날 찾고 있구나' 생각했죠. 그래서 소리쳤어요. '간다! 간다! 나 파이프라인 안에 있어, 간다! 간다!'

quotes.speaker: Kazim Ali Jr. (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: Me, too! Me, too! I inside the pipeline too, boy! Is me, Kaz! Kaz, boy! Kaz!
quotes.context: Kazim Ali Jr.'s reply in the dark when Boodram shouted that he was inside the pipeline. Recounted in the Sunday Express exclusive (13 Mar 2022). At the CoE (22 Nov 2022) Boodram also testified that he first heard Ali Jr. call out to him. That testimony is reported only as a paraphrase (T&T Guardian).
reported_by: Sunday Express, 'The Day I Cheated Death', Anna Ramdass, 13 Mar 2022 (link above)
T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 22 Nov 2022 (paraphrase only: 'He said he heard Ali Jr call out to him and thought his colleagues were outside the pipe')
quotes.korean: 나도! 나도! 나도 파이프라인 안에 있어! 나야, 카즈! 카즈라고! 카즈!

quotes.speaker: Yusuf Henry and Christopher Boodram (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: Then I heard somebody bawling out and I shouted, 'Who is that?!' Yusuf answer and say, 'Chris, is me, boy, brother boy,' and he bawling. I asked him if he alright, and he say, 'No, boy, my hand break and my foot break.' I say, 'Alright, relax yourself, we have to get out of this,'
quotes.context: Inside the air pocket shortly after the suction. Sunday Express exclusive (13 Mar 2022). The GoPro audio played at the CoE independently backs up Henry's broken foot, and so does Boodram's CoE testimony.
reported_by: Sunday Express, 'The Day I Cheated Death', Anna Ramdass, 13 Mar 2022 (link above)
Trinidad Express, 23 Nov 2022 (CoE paraphrase: 'Henry, he said, was in immense pain as his foot was broken')
quotes.korean: 그때 누군가 울부짖는 소리가 들려서 '누구야?!' 하고 소리쳤어요. 유수프가 울면서 대답했어요. '크리스, 나야, 형제.' 괜찮냐고 물었더니 '아니, 손도 부러지고 발도 부러졌어'라고 했어요. 저는 '알았어, 진정해. 우리 여기서 나가야 돼'라고 했죠.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified diver ('Diver 1') and Christopher Boodram (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: Diver 1: We inside the pipeline. Where allyuh / Diver 1: Chris! / Boodram: Yeah! / Diver 1: Yuh hearing me? / Diver 1: I right behind allyuh! I inside the pipe. / Boodram: I inside the pipe too. / Diver 1: Well, we behind you. / Boodram: I trying to come up.
quotes.context: This is a real recording made inside the pipe, not a recollection. Kazim Ali Jr. wore the GoPro on his forehead. Paria recovered the camera after the bodies were flushed out. The footage runs about 29 minutes, and 6 min 55 s was played publicly for the first time on CoE Day 1, Monday 21 Nov 2022, after a viewer-discretion warning. The video goes black after the suction, but the audio continues. The speaker labels belong to the T&T Guardian's transcription; the reporter could not identify 'Diver 1'. The Express transcribed the opening as: "We inside the pipe! We inside the pipeline!"
reported_by: T&T Guardian, 'Harrowing moments after divers sucked into pipeline', Kevon Felmine, dated 21 Nov 2022 (print 22 Nov): https://www.guardian.co.tt/news/harrowing-moments-after-divers-sucked-into-pipeline-6.2.1573299.784a913c3a

Trinidad Express, 'Voices from the watery grave', Anna Ramdass, 22 Nov 2022 (partial): https://trinidadexpress.com/news/local/voices-from-the-watery-grave/article_d6da4548-6a03-11ed-990c-afda6e01829b.html
quotes.korean: 다이버1: 우리 파이프라인 안이야. 다들 어디 있어? / 다이버1: 크리스! / 부드램: 응! / 다이버1: 내 말 들려? / 다이버1: 나 너희 바로 뒤에 있어! 파이프 안이야. / 부드램: 나도 파이프 안이야. / 다이버1: 그럼 우리가 네 뒤에 있는 거네. / 부드램: 올라가 보려고 하는 중이야.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: Come allyuh, we have to go. All ah we in this together. We have to start moving.
quotes.context: Recorded on Ali Jr.'s GoPro inside the pipe on 25 Feb 2022 and played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022. The T&T Guardian headlined it as one of Boodram's last pleas to his colleagues. The two papers transcribed it slightly differently.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 21/22 Nov 2022 (link above)
Trinidad Express, Anna Ramdass, 22 Nov 2022, variant: "All ah we in this together, we hadda go, we hadda start moving."
quotes.korean: 자, 다들, 가야 돼. 우리 모두 같이 이 안에 있는 거야. 움직이기 시작해야 돼.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe; voice identified by the Express)
quotes.words_en: Allyuh doh worry, God is good and he go geh we through dis!
quotes.context: From the GoPro audio played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022. The Express wrote that Boodram's 'familiar voice is the strongest one heard' and that he is heard 'reassuring that God will help them through'. Only the Express transcribed this line.
reported_by: Trinidad Express, 'Voices from the watery grave', Anna Ramdass, 22 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 다들 걱정 마. 하나님은 선하시니까, 우리가 이걸 이겨내게 해 주실 거야!

quotes.speaker: Yusuf Henry (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: Yeah boy, my foot break!
quotes.context: From the GoPro audio played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022: Henry's reply when Boodram asked whether anything was wrong with him. The Guardian described Henry as 'trying to remain upbeat despite a broken limb'.
reported_by: Trinidad Express, Anna Ramdass, 22 Nov 2022 (verbatim)
T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 21/22 Nov 2022 (paraphrase: 'he replied that his foot was broken')
quotes.korean: 응… 내 발 부러졌어!

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram and Yusuf Henry (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: Boodram: Yusuf / Henry: Yeah boi. / Boodram: How long until you reach Fyzie? / Henry: Right now me and Fyzie coming together. / Boodram: I am talking about how far from which part you was? You and Fyzie was together all this time? / Henry: Right now me and Fyzie together / Boodram: Who with you? / Henry: Me and Fyzie alone.
quotes.context: From the GoPro audio played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022. Boodram is checking where everyone is in the dark. 'Fyzie' is Fyzal Kurban. Only the T&T Guardian printed this exchange in full; the Express summarised it.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 21/22 Nov 2022 (link above)
Trinidad Express, 22 Nov 2022 (paraphrase: 'He is heard asking Henry how far he was from Kurban and Henry replies that they are together')
quotes.korean: 부드램: 유수프! / 헨리: 어, 왜. / 부드램: 파이지한테 가려면 얼마나 걸려? / 헨리: 지금 나랑 파이지 같이 가고 있어. / 부드램: 아까 어디쯤에서 얼마나 떨어져 있었냐고. 너랑 파이지 계속 같이 있었어? / 헨리: 지금 나랑 파이지 같이 있어. / 부드램: 누구랑 같이 있어? / 헨리: 나랑 파이지 둘뿐이야.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram and Kazim Ali Jr. (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: Boodram: Kaz, where you? / Ali Jr: Right here. / Boodram: Right here where? / Ali Jr: That is a stupid question (chuckles) / Boodram: Kaz, everything alright with you? / Ali Jr: No
quotes.context: From the GoPro audio played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022. Ali Jr. answers with dark humour in pitch blackness, then admits he is not all right. Only the T&T Guardian transcribed this; '(chuckles)' is the reporter's note. Ali Jr.'s parents left the hearing room while the footage played.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 21/22 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 부드램: 카즈, 어디야? / 알리 주니어: 여기. / 부드램: 여기 어디? / 알리 주니어: 그거 바보 같은 질문이다 (웃음) / 부드램: 카즈, 너 괜찮아? / 알리 주니어: 아니.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram and Fyzal Kurban (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: Chris: Fyz, anything happened to you / Kurban: No boy.
quotes.context: From the GoPro audio played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022. Only the T&T Guardian transcribed this. The Guardian adds that the clip ended with another moan from Rishi Nagassar, who could not speak. Do not use that sound.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 21/22 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 크리스: 파이즈, 너 어디 다친 데 없어? / 쿠르반: 없어.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (GoPro audio recorded inside the pipe)
quotes.words_en: I can't go more. I am pushing more oil.
quotes.context: From the GoPro audio played at the CoE on 21 Nov 2022, apparently while he tried to climb or move up the pipe. Only the T&T Guardian transcribed it, and the meaning is ambiguous: crawling forward was pushing oil ahead of him.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 21/22 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 더는 못 가겠어. 계속 기름만 밀어내고 있어.

quotes.speaker: Kazim Ali Jr. (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: He heard the other divers, asking, "Kazim, you all right?". He said Ali replied, "No. I in real pain. I mash up bad."
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022, describing the moments after the divers found one another in the air pocket. Only Newsday reported it.
reported_by: Newsday, 'CoE hears Paria survivor's tale: Nightmare', 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: (다른 다이버들이) '카짐, 괜찮아?' 하고 물었고, 알리는 '아니. 진짜 아파. 몸이 완전 망가졌어'라고 대답했어요.

quotes.speaker: Kazim Ali Jr. (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: We going and dead
quotes.context: Ali Jr.'s cry of despair in the pipe, as Boodram recounted it at the CoE on 22 Nov 2022. Boodram became inconsolable telling it, and the chairman called a 20-minute break. Other outlets give only a paraphrase.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 22 Nov 2022 (verbatim)
Trinidad Express, 23 Nov 2022 (paraphrase: 'words from Ali Jr, saying they were going to die and for Boodram to not leave them')
Sunday Express, 13 Mar 2022 (paraphrase: 'Kazim said they were all going to die')
quotes.korean: 우리 이제 죽는 거야.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (recounting what he told the others)
quotes.words_en: I said 'no, we're not going to die. We're coming out of here, boy. We have to get out of this. God is good.'
quotes.context: His answer to the others' fear, as he recounted it at the CoE on 22 Nov 2022.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
Trinidad Express, 23 Nov 2022, variant: "I said, 'We have to get out of this, God is good, we have to get out of this,'"
quotes.korean: 제가 말했어요. '아니, 우린 안 죽어. 우린 여기서 나갈 거야. 여기서 빠져나가야 돼. 하나님은 선하셔.'

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (recounting the prayer he led in the pipe)
quotes.words_en: I said before we do this, let we say a prayer, and I call out on Jesus and I pray to the Lord. I said, 'Father God, help we get out of there, give us a miracle, send somebody to save we, Father Lord, give we the strength.' Yusuf start praying loudly with me,
quotes.context: Spoken just before the men formed a human chain to crawl out. Sunday Express exclusive (13 Mar 2022). Three other sources corroborate the praying: his brother Larry told the Express on 27 Feb 2022 that 'those men were praying out loud'; the Ramlogan-team attorneys' letter of 22 Mar 2022 said the GoPro recorded the men 'praying and comforting each other'; and Boodram testified at the CoE that they prayed together.
reported_by: Sunday Express, 'The Day I Cheated Death', Anna Ramdass, 13 Mar 2022 (link above)

Trinidad Express, 'Fight for Life', Carolyn Kissoon & Richard Charan, 28 Feb 2022 (corroboration via Larry Boodram): https://trinidadexpress.com/news/local/fight-for-life/article_dc596dba-9839-11ec-8233-73d61ffafc30.html
quotes.korean: '이걸 하기 전에 기도하자'고 했어요. 예수님을 부르며 주님께 기도했죠. '하나님 아버지, 우리가 여기서 나가게 도와주세요. 기적을 주세요. 우리를 구해 줄 누군가를 보내 주세요. 주님, 우리에게 힘을 주세요.' 유수프가 저와 함께 큰 소리로 기도하기 시작했어요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (recounting what he told Fyzal Kurban)
quotes.words_en: Nobody can help us here but God.
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. Newsday: 'He recalled telling Kurban...'. Only Newsday reported it.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 여기선 하나님 말고는 아무도 우리를 도울 수 없어.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram
quotes.words_en: Inside there was like an unbelievable nightmare. Your eyes burning. Every time you try to open your eyes it burning. Pitch black – you can't see anything. Your throat burning. Your ears ringing. Your body sore.
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022, describing conditions in the oil- and water-filled 30-inch pipe. He asked for a break straight afterwards.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)

T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 22 Nov 2022, variant: "Mind you all, in there was like an unbelievable nightmare. Your eyes are burning. Every time you try to open your eyes, it burns. It is pitch black; you cannot see anything. Your throat is burning. Your ears are ringing, and your body is sore,"
quotes.korean: 그 안은 믿을 수 없는 악몽 같았어요. 눈이 타들어 가요. 눈을 뜰 때마다 타는 듯 따가워요. 칠흑같이 어두워서 아무것도 안 보여요. 목이 타들어 가고, 귀가 울리고, 온몸이 쑤셔요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram
quotes.words_en: Inside there was not just a crawl through a pipe like how plenty of people might be thinking.
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022.
reported_by: T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 22 Nov 2022 (link above); CNC3 mirror, 23 Nov 2022: https://www.cnc3.co.tt/paria-diving-tragedy-survivor-breaks-down-during-testimonyi-felt-angel-of-death-was-coming-for-me/
quotes.korean: 그 안은 많은 사람들이 생각하는 것처럼 그냥 파이프 속을 기어가는 게 아니었어요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram
quotes.words_en: Trying to stay calm and keep those fellars calm was one of the hardest things I've ever had to do in this life.
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. Only Newsday reported it.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
Newsday, 22 Nov 2022 (paraphrase: 'KEEPING his colleagues calm was one of the most difficult things Christopher Boodram ... has ever experienced')
quotes.korean: 제가 침착함을 유지하면서 그 친구들까지 진정시키는 건, 제 인생에서 해야 했던 일 중 가장 힘든 일 중 하나였어요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (about Yusuf Henry)
quotes.words_en: Yusuf was in pain but was a fighter. He had resilience to a different level.
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. A respectful line suitable for the in-memoriam section. Only Newsday reported it.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 유수프는 고통스러워했지만 투사였어요. 회복력이 차원이 달랐죠.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram (about Kazim Ali Jr., Fyzal Kurban and Yusuf Henry)
quotes.words_en: If they didn't know which direction to go in, I'd be dead today,
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. He thought he had been swept in head-first and was heading the wrong way, toward sealed Berth 5. The men who died told him the way out was toward open Berth 6.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (verbatim; link above)

T&T Guardian, Sharlene Rampersad, 22 Nov 2022 (paraphrase: he 'credits his deceased colleagues for directing him out of the pipeline'): https://www.guardian.co.tt/news/lone-survivor-boodrams-heartbreaking-testimony-i-failed-them-6.2.1573745.7da9339657
Trinidad Express, 23 Nov 2022 (paraphrase: 'had they not told him this, he would have not made it out of the pipe')
quotes.korean: 그들이 어느 방향으로 가야 하는지 알려주지 않았다면, 저는 지금 살아 있지 못했을 거예요.

quotes.speaker: Yusuf Henry and Kazim Ali Jr. ('Smalls'), and Christopher Boodram (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: Both Yusuf and Smalls (Ali Jr) saying, 'Brother, don't go nah, boy.' I say, 'I have to go, brother boy. If I stay here, all of we will die, none of we will see our children. I have to go get help,'
quotes.context: The moment Boodram decided to swim ahead through a flooded section to get help. Sunday Express exclusive (13 Mar 2022). The parenthetical '(Ali Jr)' is the newspaper's.
reported_by: Sunday Express, 'The Day I Cheated Death', Anna Ramdass, 13 Mar 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 유수프와 스몰스(알리 주니어) 둘 다 '형제, 제발 가지 마'라고 했어요. 저는 '가야 돼, 형제. 내가 여기 남으면 우리 다 죽어. 아무도 자기 아이들을 다시 못 봐. 가서 도움을 데려와야 해'라고 했죠.

quotes.speaker: Kazim Ali Jr. and Christopher Boodram (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: Kaz said, 'Don't go. I said, 'I have to.'
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. Newsday printed it with an unclosed quotation mark, as reproduced here. The T&T Guardian printed a related line from the same testimony: "Small Kaz (Ali Jr) was holding me. I said I am not coming out the pipe without you all. I would never leave you all."
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine, 22 Nov 2022 (related line)
quotes.korean: 카즈가 '가지 마'라고 했어요. 저는 '가야 돼'라고 했죠. (가디언 보도: "스몰 카즈가 저를 붙잡고 있었어요. 저는 '너희 없이는 이 파이프에서 안 나가. 절대 너희를 두고 가지 않아'라고 했어요.")

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram
quotes.words_en: I tell them, 'Fellahs, I coming back, I promise, I coming back, I guarantee I coming back….' Look how I fail them,
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. His promise when he left the three men behind, followed by his breakdown on the stand: he sobbed and apologised for 'being a big man who was crying', and chairman Jerome Lynch KC told him no apology was needed. The T&T Guardian headlined it "I failed them" ('"I failed them," he cried').
reported_by: Trinidad Express, 'Sea of Tears', Anna Ramdass, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
T&T Guardian, Sharlene Rampersad, 22 Nov 2022 ('I failed them') (link above)
TTT Live Online YouTube clip 'Diving Survivor: 'I Failed Them'' (video id SEJWFkdK3wA): audio source
quotes.korean: '얘들아, 나 돌아올게. 약속해, 돌아올게. 반드시 돌아올게…' 그런데 보세요, 제가 그들을 저버렸어요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram
quotes.words_en: Kazim tell me yeah (he could go) but he could not let go of my foot. I had to pull my foot off of Kazim, kind of kick it off him…I had to yank it out,
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022. Very sensitive: Ali Jr.'s parents attended the hearings, and Newsday rendered it only as 'He said he kicked his foot free of someone's grasp.' The parenthetical is the Express's.
reported_by: Trinidad Express, 'Sea of Tears', Anna Ramdass, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (paraphrase)
quotes.korean: 카짐은 (가도 된다고) '그래'라고 했지만, 제 발을 놓지 못했어요. 카짐에게서 발을 떼어내야 했어요. 거의 걷어차듯이… 억지로 빼내야 했어요.

quotes.speaker: Christopher Boodram
quotes.words_en: I have to try because failure is death.
quotes.context: CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022, on deciding to push ahead alone through the flooded pipe. Only Newsday reported it.
reported_by: Newsday, 23 Nov 2022 (link above)
quotes.korean: 해 봐야 했어요. 실패는 곧 죽음이니까요.

quotes.speaker: Fyzal Kurban and Christopher Boodram (as recounted by Boodram)
quotes.words_en: "Fyzie said, 'Christopher, I'm right here. Wait for me.' / "I said, 'I can't wait for you. If we have to save anybody, we've got to get out of here. Fyzie, I can't wait."

quotes.notes:
I collected 41 quotes with exact English wording, speaker, setting and sources. They fall into three groups: (a) the actual GoPro recording from inside the pipe, (b) Boodram's own lines and what he says the others told him, (c) the commission's findings. The user's recalled line exists: Newsday printed "I did not know if I was in heaven or hell, or in a pipe" from his testimony on 22 Nov 2022. Other outlets wrote the same Creole sentence differently, so I marked it "disputed". The subtitle has to match whatever audio is actually used.

1) Real in-pipe dialogue vs recollection (most important for the "splice")
- A real recording exists. Kazim Ali Jr wore a GoPro on his forehead; Paria recovered it after the pipe was flushed. The footage is about 29 min long, and 6 min 55 s was played publicly once, on CoE Day 1, Monday 21 Nov 2022, with a viewer-discretion warning. Ali Jr's parents left the room while it played. Only the T&T Guardian (Kevon Felmine) and the Express (Anna Ramdass) published transcripts. The speaker labels are the reporters' guesses; the Guardian could not identify "Diver 1".
- My advice: do not put the GoPro audio itself in the Reel. These are the last hours of dying men, including Rishi Nagassar moaning, and the families showed visible distress. It was entered as evidence, and the copies on YouTube are unofficial with unclear rights. If the dialogue is used, show it as on-screen text labelled [실제 녹음 · 카짐 알리 주니어의 고프로, 2022.11.21 조사위 공개 · 가디언TT 녹취]. Never use the moans.
- Everything else is Boodram's recollection, told on different occasions in different words: Sunday Express 13 Mar 2022, Sunday Guardian 16 Apr 2022, CoE 22 Nov 2022, Feb 2023, Daily Mail 2025. Label each one, for example [생존자 회상 · 조사위 증언 2022.11.22]. Do not splice recorded lines and recalled lines together as if they were one recording, and do not reorder lines in a way that changes their meaning.
- The papers turned Creole speech into text differently. Before subtitling any real clip, transcribe that clip itself. I have a local transcriber that works offline: faster-whisper, medium model cached. Run: `python3 -I /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-aireels/82e206d8-83ed-5019-be3d-65c96a1bf62c/scratchpad/tx.py <audiofile> medium`.

2) Audio sources for Boodram's voice (none could be downloaded from here)
- YouTube blocks this cloud IP with a bot check, and the auto-mode classifier refused my attempt to work around it, so I stopped. You will need to get these clips yourself, and they are the broadcasters' copyright:
  - Full CoE testimony, 22 Nov 2022: "Chris Boodram Testifies - Commission of Inquiry - Paria Tragedy - Trinidad" (YouTube vXEPmVaxCos, third-party upload, about 97 min). This is the best source for the heaven/hell, "I failed them", angel of death and "Fellahs, I coming back" lines.
  - Short CoE clips: Trinidad Express "Boodram Breaks Down" (yUuOOcQOJAI, 75 s); TTT Live "Diving Survivor: 'I Failed Them'" (SEJWFkdK3wA); TTT "Divers' Footage Seen At Paria Commission Of Enquiry" (CzrUVWV0UkU).
  - Interviews: TT Newsday "Survivor of Paria tragedy speaks with Newsday" (LI6IndcrUxI, 25 Feb 2023); Power102fm full ordeal interview (rXaVer-Wb88, 26 Jan 2024, 1 h 41 min); TTT studio interview (IFCmjD7pw1Q, 23 Jan 2026); Express "$1M doesn't 'fill the gap'" (226vCKCYd20).
  - TV6's Dailymotion clip "Boodram: They Were All Alive" (x890swj, 14 Mar 2022) is now private.
  - Daily Mail's podcast "Pipeline" (ep. 2 "Into the Pipe", 22 May 2025) and its TikTok are Daily Mail copyright.
- Korean law (저작권법 제28조, quotation of published works) may cover short attributed clips, but Instagram may still mute or block them. Licensing or asking the broadcaster is safer.
- The one clip I could download (Express Dailymotion x891bq8) turned out to be footage of the Dec 2021 explosion, not Boodram speaking. It is not useful; it sits in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-aireels/82e206d8-83ed-5019-be3d-65c96a1bf62c/scratchpad/media/.

3) Do not use these lines
- Defamation risk:
  - Boodram's March 2022 allegations that Paria "made a conscious decision to murder my friends", that it was "first degree murder", and that the Coast Guard pointed a gun. These are accusations, not findings.
  - His contested exchange about Collin Piper ("Why would I call Mr Piper to say I think them fellars dead?").
  - Do not present any named individual (Piper, Mushtaq Mohammed, Kazim Ali Sr) as guilty. The report said Piper's conduct "falls short of criminal liability" as an individual. Kazim Ali Sr is both a victim's father and an OSH defendant.
- Safe-messaging risk: "Sometimes, I wish I had died in that pipe too" and "sometimes I feel like taking my own life" are suicidal ideation. If you mention his trauma, end with a Korean crisis line (109 / 1393).

4) Safe wording for the findings (state them as the commission's)
- The CoE report was handed to the President on 30 Nov 2023 and made public on 19 Jan 2024. It found Paria's negligence "could be characterised as gross negligence and consequently criminal" and recommended that the DPP consider "corporate manslaughter". It did not reach the same conclusion for LMCS, finding LMCS was effectively prevented from attempting a rescue, but it found both companies created the hazard and both had a duty to try a rescue.
- Two other report lines to use: "the opportunity to rescue the men ... was completely wasted by a degree of inertia that is difficult to comprehend" and "no rescue attempt was ever made by them" (about Paria's incident command).

5) Legal status as of Nov 2026 (latest reports: Guardian 15 Aug 2026, Express 25 Feb 2026, Guardian 31 Mar 2026)
- OSH Act charges: filed in 2024 against Paria, LMCS, Mushtaq Mohammed, Collin Piper and Kazim Ali Sr. All pleaded not guilty in Sept 2024. The Privy Council ruled on 16 Sep 2025 (OSH Authority v UWI) that a six-month time limit applies to these prosecutions, so the charges may be dismissed as out of time. Magistrate Marisa Gomez adjourned the case to 11 Dec 2026 for a ruling.
- Manslaughter: DPP Roger Gaspard said in July 2024 that "corporate manslaughter" does not exist in T&T law and ordered a police investigation into manslaughter by gross negligence. As of Feb 2026 no charges had been laid and the families had heard nothing.
- Civil claims: negligence suits by Boodram and the families against Paria and LMCS are pending in the High Court.
- Ex gratia payments: TT$1M each, without admission of liability, paid on 22 Jan 2026 to Boodram and the Nagassar and Kurban families. The Henry and Ali Jr families were still pending as of 31 Mar 2026.
- Suggested Korean line: "2026년 11월 현재 관련 형사·민사 절차는 진행 중이며 유죄 판결은 없다."

6) Facts and discrepancies
- Accident: Friday 25 Feb 2022, about 2:30–3 pm, Berth 6, Sealine No. 36 riser, Pointe-a-Pierre. The pipe was 30 inches across (some early reports said 36). Boodram crawled for about 3 hours and was rescued by Ronald Ramoutar and Corey Crawford, who defied orders not to dive.
- Ages: Kurban 57, Nagassar 48, Ali Jr 36, Henry 31. Boodram's age is reported as 34, 36 or 40, so omit it.
- Bodies: Ali Jr, Henry and Kurban were recovered on 28 Feb 2022. Nagassar's recovery is dated 1, 2 or 3 March depending on the source, so write "3월 초".
- How long the four survived: two pathologists, cited by commission counsel, estimated from hours up to 26–28 Feb, and their estimates differ. Attribute this as "부검 소견상 수 시간~수일 생존 가능".
- Nicknames: Fyzie / Fyz (Kurban); Kaz, Small Kaz or Smalls (Ali Jr); Rishi "Blacks" (Nagassar); Rolly (Ramoutar). Nagassar's name is also spelled Nagessar or Naggasar.
- UNILAD's write-up has errors ("48 hours", "flushed six days after"). Wikipedia wrongly says the report was released in Nov 2023.

KEY FACTS AND DATES (confirmed)
- Incident: Friday 25 Feb 2022, Berth 6 (No. 36 sealine riser), Pointe-a-Pierre.
- Commission hearings: Day 1 evidence on Monday 21 Nov 2022, when the GoPro audio was first played publicly (Guardian TT, Kevon Felmine). The venue was the International Waterfront Centre, Port of Spain.
- Boodram testified on Tuesday 22 Nov 2022 (Guardian TT, Sharlene Rampersad: 'on Tuesday morning'; TV6 package aired that night).
- The report went to President Kangaloo on 30 Nov 2023. Cabinet referred it to the DPP in January 2024.
- The Commissioners were Jerome Lynch KC (chair) and Gregory Wilson. Lynch singled out Boodram for 'his undoubted commitment in doing all he could to help his friends'.
- The report found his evidence truthful. It said the GoPro audio bears out his account of the air-pocket talk, the linking together, the encouragement and the prayers.
- Nicknames: 'Fyzie' = Fyzal Kurban; 'Blacks' = Rishi Nagassar; 'Kaz' / 'small Kaz' = Kazim Ali Jr.

WHO SAID WHAT: keep the three layers separate in the subtitles
(a) Real in-pipe audio (GoPro, 25 Feb 2022, played 21 Nov 2022). Subtitle from the Guardian TT transcript (21-22 Nov 2022), not from ASR:
  - Boodram: 'Come allyuh, we have to go. All ah we in this together. We have to start moving.'
  - Boodram: 'Kaz, where you?' / Ali Jr: 'Right here.' / Boodram: 'Right here where?' / Ali Jr: 'That is a stupid question.' / Boodram: 'Kaz, everything alright with you?' / Ali Jr: 'No.'
  - Henry: 'Right now me and Fyzie together.' / Kurban: 'No boy.'
  - Express transcript (unattributed): 'Allyuh doh worry, God is good and he go geh we through dis!' / Henry: 'Yeah boy, my foot break!'
(b) Boodram's sworn recollection (22 Nov 2022), quoted verbatim in the CoE report pp. 172-178:
  - 'Who is dah, boy?' / 'Boy, Kaz boy.' / 'Kaz, yuh awright?' / 'No, boy; ah in real pain'
  - Kazim: 'boy, we going and dead.' / Boodram: 'no. Doh say dat. We nuh going and dead in here.'
  - 'ah fail dem in every other way. Ah apologize.'
(c) His later retellings: Express interview, 11 Mar 2022; Daily Mail interview, Feb 2025.
  - Express: 'I promise each and every one of them that I will come back and if I can't, help will come.'
  - Express: 'I have to go, brother boy. If I stay here, all of we will die, none of we will see our children. I have to go get help.'
  - Daily Mail: 'Kaz was like, Chris, don't go and leave me' and 'The hardest thing I had to do was to kick off that man.'
Label (b) and (c) on screen as his recollection, for example '크리스토퍼 부드람 증언, 조사위원회 2022.11.22' or '부드람 인터뷰, Daily Mail 팟캐스트 2025'. Do not label them as recorded dialogue. The dialogue was spoken in Trinidadian English, so translate it faithfully and do not add words.

COMMISSION FINDINGS: state them as findings
- 'sufficient grounds to conclude that Paria's negligence could be characterised as gross negligence and consequently criminal'.
- It recommended that the DPP consider charging Paria with 'what is commonly known as Corporate Manslaughter'.
- It did not reach that conclusion for LMCS, because LMCS was 'effectively prevented from pursuing a rescue by Paria'.
- It found evidence to justify OSH Act prosecutions of Paria and LMCS as employers, and of Collin Piper and Kazim Ali Sr individually.
- It found no strong enough case for manslaughter against any individual.

LEGAL STATUS: no conviction of anyone; re-check right before publishing
- My searches found nothing after about mid-2026.
- The DPP said Trinidad and Tobago has no statutory corporate-manslaughter offence; only manslaughter by gross negligence is possible. The DPP advised a police probe. I found no report of manslaughter charges.
- OSH Act charges were filed in September 2024 against Paria, LMCS and individuals, and all pleaded not guilty. After the Privy Council's September 2025 ruling (UWI v OSHA) that criminal OSH complaints must be filed within six months, the Paria case was reported 'in limbo' pending a magistrate's ruling. Guardian TT items 6.2.2646282 and 6.2.2420836 cover this.
- Civil negligence suits by Boodram (amended claim November 2025; case management conference 5 May 2026) and by the families are pending.
- In January 2026 the government paid TT$1M ex gratia to Boodram and to each family.
- Do NOT use the Express interview from 02:12 to 05:22, where he calls it 'murder' / 'first-degree murder', unless it is framed and legally reviewed as his allegation.

ETHICS
- The GoPro recording is the actual voices of four men who died. Use only short lines of Boodram encouraging the others.
- Never use the groans or moans: about 3:42-3:50 and the final seconds, attributed to Rishi Nagassar.
- Add a content warning. Consider that the families still campaign publicly.

segments.narration_ko: 2022년, 트리니다드 토바고. 국영기업 파리아의 해저 송유관을 고치던 하청 잠수부 다섯 명.
segments.attribution: 사실관계 출처: T&T Guardian, Trinidad Express, 조사위원회 보고서
segments.visual: 카리브해 지도에서 트리니다드 서해안 Pointe-à-Pierre에 핀을 꽂는다. 텍스트: '2022.2.25 · 6번 부두(Berth 6)'. 단면도에 바지선, 수직 라이저, 해저로 이어지는 U자형 관(약 400m)을 그리고 라벨을 단다: 'Paria Fuel Trading (국영)', '하청 LMCS 잠수부 5명', '관 지름 30인치 ≈ 76cm (36은 관 번호)'. 사람 대신 작은 빛점 다섯 개로 표시한다.

segments.narration_ko: 수중 작업 챔버에서 마개를 빼는 순간, 관 속 압력 차가 다섯 명을 빨아들였습니다.
segments.attribution: 카드 출처: 부드램 조사위원회 증언 2022.11.22 (T&T Guardian, Kevon Felmine 보도). 원인 설명: 조사위원회 보고서(배관을 비운 방식이 남긴 잠재 압력 차 ΔP)
segments.visual: 라이저 윗부분을 감싼 수중 '해비타트'(공기로 물을 밀어낸 작업 챔버) 단면. 관 입구의 풍선형 마개가 쪼그라들고, 게이지가 관 안 '저압'과 바깥 '고압'을 보여 주며 'ΔP(델타 P)' 화살표가 나타난다. 챔버 수위가 급히 오른다. 1.5초 동안 증언 카드: "Allyuh, what going on? Look, this thing is filling up. Let we get out of here." / '다들, 무슨 일이야? 물이 차오르고 있어. 여기서 나가자.' 라벨은 [부드램 증언(회상) · 조사위원회 2022.11.22]. 끝으로 빛점 다섯 개가 관 입구의 어둠 속으로 사라지며 암전한다. 사람 형체나 충격 장면은 그리지 않는다.

segments.clip: 로컬 파일 /home/user/aireels/assets/paria_media/dailymail_pipeline_ep2_into_the_pipe.mp3, 13:34.60–13:39.30 (814.60–819.30 s, 4.7초, 앞뒤 80ms 페이드). 화자는 크리스토퍼 부드램뿐이고 진행자 음성은 없다. 들리는 말(medium ASR 두 번 대조): "But to me, I wasn't even sure if I was alive... and [if] this [was] hell". 마지막 두세 단어는 ASR에서 'and these hell'로 나와 불명확하므로 귀로 듣고 자막을 확정한다. Daily Mail 지면 표기는 'I wasn't sure if I was alive or if this was hell'. 817.55–818.30에 약 0.7초 멈춤이 있는데 잘라 내지 않는다. 대안(더 좋은 원본이지만 이 환경에서는 다운로드 불가): 조사위원회 증언 2022.11.22 TTT 생중계 Part 1, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1nRiXsUUWA0. 보고서 p.172 원문은 'Ah not sure if ah alive... if ah in hell; if ah in heaven; if ah in ah pipe'이며 영상 내 타임스탬프는 확인하지 못했다.
segments.subtitle_ko: 제가 살아 있는 건지… 여기가 지옥인 건지도 확신할 수 없었어요.
segments.attribution: 크리스토퍼 부드램(유일한 생존자) · 2025년 회상 인터뷰 · Daily Mail 팟캐스트 'Pipeline' Ep.2 ⓒDMG Media
segments.visual: 완전한 암흑 위로 미세한 기름막 반사광이 일렁이고, 가운데에 가는 주황색 음성 파형. 하단에 한글 자막과 원문 영어를 작게 함께 넣는다. 이름표 '크리스토퍼 부드램 · 생존자'. 얼굴이나 사진은 쓰지 않는다.

segments.narration_ko: 그런데 다섯 명 모두 살아 있었습니다. 카메라에 그 목소리가 남았죠.
segments.attribution: 출처: T&T Guardian · Trinidad Express (2022.11.21–22). 조사위원회 보고서는 고프로 음성이 부드램의 증언을 뒷받침한다고 밝힘
segments.visual: 칠흑 같은 관 내부 단면에 빛점 다섯 개가 하나씩 켜진다(누가 어디에 있는지는 표시하지 않는다). 상단 텍스트: '카짐 알리 Jr.가 머리에 단 고프로 — 영상은 사고 순간 끊겼지만 음성은 계속 녹음됨 (약 29분 중 6분 55초, 2022.11.21 조사위원회에서 공개)'. 꺼진 화면 아이콘 옆에서 녹음 파형만 계속 움직인다.

segments.clip: [조건부: 유족 동의와 권리 확인이 있을 때만 사용] 로컬 파일 /home/user/aireels/assets/paria_media/gopro_audio_commission_played_TTT_archiveorg.mp4, 3:55.5–3:59.2 (235.5–239.2 s, 약 3.7초, 오디오만, 100ms 페이드). 원본은 2022.11.21 조사위원회에서 공개된 증거물이며, 이 파일은 TTT 방송분을 제3자가 archive.org에 올린 미러다. TTT 원본 뉴스: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CzrUVWV0UkU. 화자는 크리스토퍼 부드램. T&T Guardian 녹취: "Come allyuh, we have to go. All ah we in this together. We have to start moving." Trinidad Express 녹취: "All ah we in this together, we hadda go, we hadda start moving." 잡음이 심해 ASR로 검증할 수 없으므로 반드시 귀로 듣고 실제로 들리는 부분만 자막으로 넣는다. 경계 주의: 3:42–3:50의 신음(리시 나가사르로 보도됨)과 3:52의 'Who making all that noise' 구간은 절대 넣지 않는다. 클립 아래에 다른 사람의 신음이 깔려 있으면 사용하지 않는다. 동의가 없을 때의 대체안: 오디오 없이 같은 녹취를 텍스트 카드로 3.7초 보여 주고 낮은 앰비언스만 깐다.
segments.subtitle_ko: 자, 다들! 가야 돼. 우린 다 같이 이 안에 있어. 이제 움직여야 돼!
segments.attribution: 실제 녹음 · 2022.2.25 관 속 · 카짐 알리 Jr.의 고프로 음성 (2022.11.21 조사위원회 공개) · 목소리: 크리스토퍼 부드램 · 녹취: T&T Guardian
segments.visual: 암흑 속에 청록색 녹음 파형만 보인다. 좌상단에 빨간 점과 'REC 실제 녹음' 배지. 한글 자막과 원문 크리올 영어를 함께 넣는다. 사진이나 재연 장면은 쓰지 않는다.

segments.narration_ko: 칠흑 같은 관 속, 다친 몸으로 서로를 부르며 기어갔습니다.
segments.attribution: 카드 출처: 고프로 음성 녹취, T&T Guardian (Kevon Felmine, 2022.11.21–22)
segments.visual: 옆에서 본 관 단면에 기름과 물이 약 8~10인치 깊이로 차 있고, 빛점 다섯 개가 사슬처럼 이어져 조금씩 움직인다. 녹음 순서대로 텍스트 카드 두 장을 오디오 없이 띄운다. ① 부드램 "Kaz, everything alright with you?" / 알리 Jr. "No." (카즈, 너 괜찮아? / 아니.) ② 부드램 "Fyz, anything happened to you?" / 쿠르반 "No boy." (파이즈, 다친 데 없어? / 없어.) 라벨은 [실제 녹음 녹취 · 고프로 음성 · T&T Guardian 녹취]. 신음이나 고통스러운 소리는 쓰지 않는다.

segments.narration_ko: 물이 차오르자, 크리스토퍼 부드램이 먼저 나가 도움을 데려오기로 합니다.
segments.attribution: 출처: 조사위원회 보고서 pp.175–176 (부드램 증언)
segments.visual: 관 단면의 수위가 천장 가까이 차올라 약 15cm 틈만 남는다. 빛점 하나(부드램)가 산소통 아이콘을 들고 앞으로 떨어져 나가고, 나머지 넷은 공기층에 남는다. 텍스트: '산소통 2개 · 부상자와 함께 잠수해 이동할 수 없었음 (조사위원회 보고서)'.

segments.clip: 로컬 파일 /home/user/aireels/assets/paria_media/express_2022-03-13_the_day_i_cheated_death_x890pgy.mp4, 1:56.70–2:02.95 (116.70–122.95 s, 6.25초). 영상에 얼굴이 나오므로 오디오만 쓴다. 원본: https://www.dailymotion.com/video/x890pgy (2022.3.11 녹화, 3.13 게재). 화자는 크리스토퍼 부드램. 들리는 말(ASR 두 번 일치): "I promised each and every one of them that I'll be back for them. If I can't come back, I'll send help." 주의: 바로 뒤 2:12–5:22에 나오는 '살인' 주장 발언은 넣지 않는다. 지금 컷은 그 앞에서 끝난다.
segments.subtitle_ko: 한 명 한 명에게 다 약속했어요. 꼭 돌아오겠다고. 못 돌아오면, 도움이라도 보내겠다고.
segments.attribution: 크리스토퍼 부드램 인터뷰 · Trinidad Express (2022.3.13 공개) ⓒTrinidad Express
segments.visual: 물에 잠긴 관 속을 빛점 하나가 혼자 나아가고, 뒤에 남은 빛점 넷은 흐릿하게 보인다. 음성 파형과 자막. 얼굴은 쓰지 않는다.

segments.narration_ko: 구조된 그는 넷이 살아 있다고 알렸지만, 파리아는 구조자 안전을 이유로 관 진입을 허가하지 않았습니다.
segments.attribution: 출처: Newsday/Temponetworks (조사위원회 2022.11.21), T&T Guardian (Collin Piper 증언 2022.12), Trinidad Express 'They used the Coast Guard to stop us'
segments.visual: 타임라인 바: '오후 2시 45분경 사고(보도마다 2:15~3:00) → 약 2~3시간 뒤 부드램 구조 (자원 잠수부 2명, 파리아 허가 없이 진입)'. 수직관 위에서 손전등 빛이 내려오는 그림. 이어서 담담한 텍스트 카드: '파리아 사고 지휘부: 구조자 안전과 2차 압력 사고 우려로 관 진입 불허 (파리아 입장)' / '자원 잠수부: "해안경비대를 이용해 우리를 막았다" (진술·주장)' / '해안경비대: 관 진입 장비·훈련 없음'. 얼굴은 쓰지 않고 개인 실명도 넣지 않는다.

segments.narration_ko: 며칠 뒤에야, 그는 알게 됩니다.
segments.visual: 추상적인 어두운 방에 휴대폰 화면 불빛만 깜박인다. 날짜 카운터가 2.25 → 2.26 → 2.27 → 2.28로 넘어간다.

segments.clip: 로컬 파일 /home/user/aireels/assets/paria_media/dailymail_pipeline_ep2_into_the_pipe.mp3, 41:40.70–41:46.90 (2500.70–2506.90 s, 6.2초). 팟캐스트 배경음악이 깔려 있으므로 앞뒤 150ms 페이드를 준다. 화자는 크리스토퍼 부드램이고, 2492–2497 s에 나오는 진행자 Isabel Stanley의 멘트는 컷에서 빠져 있다. 들리는 말(medium ASR, 단어 단위): "I get to find out that these guys haven't been rescued yet." 'that' 뒤 약 1.3초 멈춤이 있는데 잘라 내지 않는다. 최종 자막 전에 귀로 확인한다.
segments.subtitle_ko: 그 친구들이 아직 구조되지 않았다는 걸 알게 됐어요.
segments.attribution: 크리스토퍼 부드램 · 2025년 회상 인터뷰 · Daily Mail 팟캐스트 'Pipeline' Ep.2 ⓒDMG Media
segments.visual: 어두운 화면에 파형과 자막. 멀리서 본 관 속에 빛점 넷이 그대로 머물러 있다.

segments.narration_ko: 네 사람은 끝내 돌아오지 못했습니다.
segments.attribution: 출처: T&T Guardian (2022.2.27), Trinidad Express 'How Rishi's body was found', T&T Guardian 사설 부검 보도 (2022)
segments.visual: 관 속 빛점 넷이 조용히 흐려진다. 죽음을 재연하는 것이 아니라 페이드로만 처리한다. 텍스트: '2.27 파리아, 구조→수습 전환 발표 · 2.28 세 명 수습 · 3월 초 마지막 한 명 수습'. 하단 각주: '유족 측 부검의 추정: 일부는 사고 뒤 수 시간~하루 이상 생존했을 가능성 — 추정이며 확정 사실 아님'.

segments.narration_ko: 조사위원회는 파리아가 구조를 사실상 막았다고 보고, 형사적 중과실로 볼 근거가 충분하다고 판단했습니다.
segments.attribution: 조사위원회 최종 보고서 권고 40·41 (Trinidad Express 'Gross negligence', 2024.1; CNC3; 보고서 원문 p.295)
segments.visual: 코드로 그린 보고서 표지(실제 로고 없음): '조사위원회 최종 보고서 · 위원장 제롬 린치 KC · 2023.11.30 제출 / 2024.1.19 공개'. 인용 하이라이트: "Paria's negligence could be characterised as gross negligence and consequently criminal" / "[LMCS] were effectively prevented from pursuing a rescue by Paria". 작은 글씨: '위험(ΔP)을 만든 건 파리아·LMCS 두 회사 모두 — 보고서' · '검찰총장(DPP)에게 이른바 기업 과실치사 기소 검토 권고'. '조사위원회 판단이며 법원 판결 아님' 표기.

segments.narration_ko: 하지만 과실치사로 기소된 사람은 아직 없고, 재판과 소송은 진행 중입니다.
segments.attribution: T&T Guardian 2024.9.11 / 2026.8.15, DPP 발표 2024.7 (T&T Guardian), Newsday 2025.11.4 / 2026.1.23, Trinidad Express 2026.2.25
segments.visual: 체크리스트 카드, 제목은 '2026년 11월 기준 확인된 보도'. • 경찰: 중과실치사 수사 중, 기소 없음 (검찰총장 2024.7 수사 권고. 트리니다드 토바고에는 '기업 과실치사'라는 법정 죄명이 없음) • 산업안전보건법 위반 15건: 파리아·LMCS·관계자 3명, 전원 무죄 주장. 6개월 기소 시한 문제로 각하 여부를 2026.12.11 판단 예정 • 민사 손해배상: 부드램·유족 대 파리아·LMCS 진행 중 • 2026.1 정부 위로금 TT$100만씩 (책임 인정 아님). 하단에 '유죄 판결 없음'. 개인 실명은 넣지 않는다. 게시 직전 12.11 판단 결과를 다시 확인한다.

segments.narration_ko: 파이잘 쿠르반. 카짐 알리 주니어. 리시 나가사르. 유수프 헨리.
segments.visual: 검은 바다 위에 코드로 그린 작은 등불 네 개가 차례로 켜지고, 이름이 영문과 한글로 나온다: Fyzal Kurban 파이잘 쿠르반 · Kazim Ali Jr. 카짐 알리 주니어 · Rishi Nagassar 리시 나가사르 · Yusuf Henry 유수프 헨리. 하단 'In memoriam · 2022.2.25'. 사진은 쓰지 않는다. 철자 변형(Nagessar, Yusuff)이 있으므로 유족 측 표기를 확인하는 것이 좋다.

draft.caption_ko:
[실화] 송유관에 빨려 들어간 5명, 살아 나온 1명
※ 실제 사고 관련 음성과 증언이 포함되어 있습니다.

2022년 2월 25일, 트리니다드 토바고 푸앵타피에르. 국영기업 파리아(Paria Fuel Trading)의 해저 송유관(지름 30인치)을 수리하던 하청업체 LMCS 잠수부 5명이 관 속 압력 차(Delta P)로 관 안에 빨려 들어갔습니다. 다섯 명 모두 처음에는 살아 있었습니다. 크리스토퍼 부드램만 약 2~3시간 만에 관 끝에 닿아 자원 잠수부들에게 구조됐습니다. 파리아는 구조자 안전을 이유로 관 진입을 허가하지 않았고, 파이잘 쿠르반·카짐 알리 주니어·리시 나가사르·유수프 헨리 네 사람은 돌아오지 못했습니다.

조사위원회(위원장 제롬 린치 KC)는 2024년 1월 공개된 보고서에서 파리아가 구조를 사실상 막았다고 판단했습니다. 또 파리아의 과실을 형사적 중과실로 볼 근거가 충분하다며 검찰총장에게 기소 검토를 권고했습니다. 위험을 만든 책임은 두 회사 모두에 있다고도 밝혔습니다. 이는 조사위원회의 판단이며 법원 판결이 아닙니다.

2026년 11월 현재 확인된 보도 기준으로, 과실치사로 기소된 사람은 없고 경찰 수사가 진행 중입니다. 산업안전보건법 위반 사건은 피고 전원이 무죄를 주장하고 있으며 기소 시한 문제에 대한 판단을 기다리고 있습니다. 민사 소송도 진행 중입니다. 유죄 판결을 받은 사람은 없습니다.

음성 출처: Daily Mail 팟캐스트 'Pipeline'(2025), Trinidad Express 인터뷰(2022.3), 조사위원회 공개 고프로 음성(2022.11.21, TTT). 관 속 대화 자막은 T&T Guardian과 Trinidad Express의 녹취를 따랐고, 실제 녹음과 증언(회상)은 구분해 표기했습니다. 모든 그림은 직접 그린 일러스트입니다.

고인들의 명복을 빕니다.

#파리아참사 #송유관 #트리니다드토바고 #잠수부 #실화 #사건사고 #DeltaP #PariaDivingTragedy

issues.problem: The card line '2026.1 정부 위로금 TT$100만씩' implies all five recipients were paid. On 22 Jan 2026 the PM paid only Boodram and the Nagassar and Kurban families. Payments to the Kazim Ali Jr and Yusuf Henry families were reported on hold over insurance and legal issues, and I found no later report that they were paid.
issues.fix_ko: '2026.1.22 생존자와 두 유족(나가사르·쿠르반)에게 TT$100만씩 위로금 지급 (책임 인정 아님) · 알리 주니어·헨리 유족 지급은 보험·법적 문제로 보류 (2026.1 보도)'로 고친다. 게시 직전에 두 유족의 지급 여부를 다시 확인한다.

issues.problem: 'In memoriam · 2022.2.25' reads as the date of death. The GoPro audio, the commission and the families all say the four were alive after the 25 Feb suction. Ali Jr's death certificate gives 28 Feb, and pathologists estimated survival from hours to days. Putting 2.25 as the death date undercuts the families' central point.
issues.fix_ko: 하단 문구를 'In memoriam · 2022년 2월 파리아 잠수부 참사' 또는 '사고일 2022.2.25'로 바꾸고, 사망일로 읽히는 날짜는 쓰지 않는다.

issues.problem: The visual shows 'five light dots linked like a chain'. Per Boodram's testimony as printed in the CoE report, Nagassar ('Blacks') was not in the chain: Yusuf said he had passed over Blacks lower down, Boodram said 'We cant stay and wait fuh he', and the chain was Boodram, Ali Jr, Henry and Kurban.
issues.fix_ko: 빛점 넷이 사슬처럼 움직이고, 다섯째 빛점은 뒤쪽에 떨어져 희미하게 둔다(정확한 위치는 표시하지 않음). 또는 사슬 개수를 아예 보여 주지 않는다.

issues.problem: 'The other four stay in the air pocket' does not match the record. When he decided to go, Boodram was with Ali Jr, Henry and Kurban; Nagassar was separate, further back. Boodram also says Kurban followed him part of the way, sharing air ('me and Fyzie... came into this air pocket'; 'Fyzie right behind').
issues.fix_ko: 남는 빛점은 셋으로 그리고, 넷째(나가사르)는 따로 떨어져 희미하게 둔다. 또는 숫자와 위치를 특정하지 않고 '나머지는 공기층에 남는다' 정도로만 표현한다. 쿠르반이 일부 구간을 따라왔다는 내용은 부드램 진술로만 처리한다.

issues.problem: The local file's provenance is not verified. The archive.org item is titled '[FULL UNEDITED FOOTAGE]...' and was uploaded 23 Jan 2024. Its description credits a YouTube re-upload and says higher-quality footage came from 'YouTube's Darkest Videos 6' from an unknown source. The filename shows a Y2meta downloader. The file is 7:52 long, not the 6:55 played at the CoE. It cannot be called 'the TTT broadcast mirror'. On ethics, the audio comes from Kazim Ali Jr's own forehead camera, and his parents walked out when it was played.
issues.fix_ko: 이 파일은 쓰지 않는다. 기본안은 대체안이다: 오디오 없이 텍스트 카드 + 낮은 앰비언스. GoPro 음성을 꼭 쓰려면 TTT 또는 조사위원회 원본을 직접 확보하고, 알리 주니어 유족과 부드램 측(Freedom Law Chambers)의 동의를 서면으로 받은 뒤에만 쓴다. 클립 노트의 'TTT 방송분 미러' 표현은 '출처 미검증 재업로드'로 고친다.

issues.problem: The subtitle follows the Guardian's order (go → all in this together → start moving). The Express transcribed the same line as 'All ah we in this together, we hadda go, we hadda start moving.' Two Whisper-medium passes on 235.5-239.2 s heard 'Come on, [let's figure it out / let's get out of here], we got to move, we got to start moving'. That ordering matches the Express, so the Korean subtitle order may not match what viewers hear. 'All ah we in this together' is also a Creole idiom ('we're all in this together'); '우린 다 같이 이 안에 있어' is a literal mistranslation.
issues.fix_ko: 귀로 확인한 순서대로 자막을 단다. Express 순서라면 '자, 다들! 우린 다 한 몸이야. 가야 돼, 이제 움직여야 돼!'로 하고, 녹취 출처를 'T&T Guardian · Trinidad Express (두 녹취의 순서가 다름)'로 표기한다.
